propositions: The bedrock_model_id field is declared on LLMConfig and populated from environment but read by nothing in src/ or tests/
The actual Bedrock model id is already carried by cfg.model as a provider-prefixed string (bedrock:<profile-id>) and parsed by providers.py
REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID is documented in env-vars.md and config.py module docstring but has never shipped and produces no effect when set
A duplicate default literal DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID exists in bedrock_model.py with a hand-sync comment that will become obsolete

Removal is safe and preferred over wiring because cfg.model already handles the use case, nothing depends on the unshipped field, and it does not support the per-pass model requirement it was investigated for
